title: Chinese DRAM memory CXMT does not turn out to be the expected economical alternative and its prices follow those of major manufacturers
summary: CXMT modules enter the market with prices matching or exceeding those of Samsung and other leaders, contradicting expectations that they would ease the market.

title: Minecraft Java Edition increases memory requirements to 16 GB for the first time in 17 years
summary: Microsoft now recommends 16 GB of RAM and a more modern CPU for the Java edition, ahead of the transition to Vulkan.

title: Microsoft tests an intelligent download client for Xbox and PC that chooses the fastest server
summary: The new feature aims to optimize game download speeds by automatically connecting to the optimal server.

title: Chinese manufacturers launch laptops with GeForce RTX 3050 in 2026 to reduce costs
summary: Several Chinese brands present models with the RTX 3050 GPU, seeking to offer more affordable options in the laptop market.
